name: PPPoE Client Lab
description: Example PPPoE lab plugin. It probes PPPoE discovery/LCP/auth primitives through the host raw L2 API and can install a minimal TC IPv4/IPv6-over-PPPoE dataplane on real or veth/vtap lab interfaces.

virtual_interfaces.description: Example logical PPPoE session endpoint used by the control-plane demo.

objects.description: Minimal TC lab dataplane that can either run a direct IPv4/IPv6-over-PPPoE tunnel or couple IPv4 PPPoE session traffic into the fvtap forward/reply pipeline.

resources.description: Runtime TC hook interface bindings. Records map a declared hook_id to one or more real Linux interfaces.
PPPoE account and interface profile used by the example actions.
Last discovery/probe results written by the control script for the UI.
Normalized WAN session state exported for wan_core and forward_core handoff.

actions.description: Send PADI and record the first PADO response.
Run discovery, open a PPPoE session, send one LCP request and optional PAP/CHAP response, then send PADT by default.
Run discovery/session setup and install the minimal TC IPv4-over-PPPoE lab tunnel without sending PADT.
Run discovery/session setup, negotiate IPCP/IPv6CP/optional DHCPv6-PD, keep the PPPoE session open, and optionally arm LCP keepalive.
Send PADT for the stored or provided session and clear keepalive.
Delete the stored last probe result.
